issues.on_page: Subscription-based information technology arrangements 6,999 + Sale of capital assets 24 = Total other financing sources 7,023
issues.issue: Amount matches the printed total. But 6,999 of it is SBITA financing, which is debt-like and could go in debt_proceeds. Recording it all as other_financing is defensible.

Statement of Activities (p3) shows Educare's 21,795 as operating grants and contributions (69% of the line) and the Foundation's and Nonmajor fund's parts as charges for services. A more specific category (or a split) may fit, but it is unclear whether those grants are federal or private, so 'other' with review is defensible.

issues.on_page: Salaries 15,832; Employee benefits 4,430; Purchased services 2,789; Supplies and materials 2,845; Depreciation/amortization 588; Other expenses 4,584; Commodities expense 532
issues.issue: Business-type spending is listed only by object, so 'other' (last resort) was used for all of it. Educare (20,345 of 31,726 per p3) is an early-childhood program that could arguably be 'instruction'. Mixed funds make this a judgment call.

The ESU No. 19 'Local sources' group is not broken down on the page. It could be property tax or contract/service revenue rather than payments from other governments. It is already marked review as a broad group.
